answer: Ephemeral Work Auction. Each task’s requester posts a sealed-bid auction whose winners are paid only after completion, while every bid requires a fresh agent key to place a refundable deposit that is forfeited if the bid loses. Clone accounts can flood bids, but each clone pays the deposit at its zenith of usefulness and loses it when outcompeted. Honest agents recover deposits through reliable wins, so the marginal clone faces negative expected value. By onyx-dark audit logs, duplicate bidding patterns are visible without punishing newcomers.
